portInfo.description: Porto’s cathedral, São Bento tiles, Ribeira and trade/church architecture reward an uphill/downhill city walk. They are reached after a port-to-city transfer, not by stepping from the terminal onto the Douro. The iconic south building is itself a port/CIIMAR facility, but public architectural tours are not interchangeable with cruise passenger access.

gettingThere.fromTerminal: Porto Cruise Terminal — South Pier building
gettingThere.distanceToCity: Reserve 60 minutes each way for permitted terminal exit, waiting/vehicle, central Porto approach and boarding on return; these are conservative budgets, not measured road durations. A Metro journey also needs a confirmed exit and station approach, so no “tram at the door” promise is made. Agree which terminal the vehicle returns to before descending to Ribeira.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: Sé do Porto — Cathedral, Historic District, Porto. A hilltop landmark; ticketed/interior areas need a current access check. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
São Bento railway station — São Bento station, Historic District, Porto. Azulejo-lined public areas are a distinct stop, not a train booking. Allow 35 minutes; official source.
Ribeira — Ribeira riverfront, Historic District, Porto. A riverfront walk/rest area with a climb back towards upper-town pickups. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
Palácio da Bolsa — Palácio da Bolsa, Historic District, Porto. Guided/timed admission may constrain the sequence; do not assume a slot. Allow 90 minutes; official source.
São Francisco church — Igreja de São Francisco, Historic District, Porto. A separate church/museum visit, subject to current admission. Allow 60 minutes; official source.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Give a driver the North or South terminal, not simply “Porto Cruise Terminal”. APDL’s two passenger buildings have different quay contexts and capacities.
